rag_final_style_view.definition:
SELECT id,
    embedding,
    retrieval_text AS text,
    jsonb_build_object('rag_item_id', (id)::text, 'source_type', source_type, 'example_role', 'style_only', 'factual_authority', false, 'target_agent', 'final_answer', 'question', customer_question, 'human_answer', human_answer, 'category', category) AS metadata
   FROM rag_items
  WHERE ((source_type = ANY (ARRAY['response_example'::text, 'style_rule'::text])) AND (quality_status = 'approved'::text) AND (approved = true) AND (active = true) AND (embedding IS NOT NULL) AND ((learning_data ->> 'target_agent'::text) = 'final_answer'::text) AND ((learning_data ->> 'example_role'::text) = 'style_only'::text) AND ((learning_data ->> 'factual_authority'::text) = 'false'::text) AND (NULLIF(btrim(retrieval_text), ''::text) IS NOT NULL) AND (NULLIF(btrim(human_answer), ''::text) IS NOT NULL));

rag_case_example_view.definition:
SELECT r.id,
    r.embedding,
    r.retrieval_text AS text,
    jsonb_build_object('rag_item_id', (r.id)::text, 'feedback_id', (r.feedback_id)::text, 'source_type', 'case_example', 'case_version', 11, 'case_revision', (r.learning_data -> 'case_revision'::text), 'origin_digest', (r.learning_data ->> 'origin_digest'::text), 'target_agent', 'case_retrieval', 'example_role', 'historical_resolution', 'factual_authority', false, 'factual_use_approved', false, 'verification_status', 'not_applicable', 'question', r.customer_question, 'human_answer', r.human_answer, 'feedback_reason', r.feedback_reason, 'confirmed_categories', (r.learning_data -> 'confirmed_categories'::text)) AS metadata
   FROM (rag_items r
     JOIN ai_feedback f ON ((f.id = r.feedback_id)))
  WHERE ((r.source_type = 'case_example'::text) AND (r.active = true) AND (r.approved = true) AND (r.quality_status = 'approved'::text) AND (r.embedding IS NOT NULL) AND (vector_dims(r.embedding) = 1536) AND (vector_norm(r.embedding) > (0)::double precision) AND (r.learning_data @> '{"case_status": "published", "case_version": 11, "example_role": "historical_resolution", "target_agent": "case_retrieval", "publish_state": "published", "privacy_checked": true, "quality_checked": true, "factual_authority": false, "factual_use_approved": false, "generalization_checked": true}'::jsonb) AND ((length(btrim(r.retrieval_text)) >= 12) AND (length(btrim(r.retrieval_text)) <= 900)) AND (length(btrim(r.customer_question)) > 0) AND (length(btrim(r.human_answer)) > 0) AND learning_case_human_source_valid_v11(f.*) AND (((f.feedback_data -> 'learning_case_v11'::text) ->> 'status'::text) = 'staged'::text) AND (md5(((f.feedback_data -> 'learning_case_v11'::text))::text) = (r.learning_data ->> 'origin_digest'::text)));

rag_verified_fact_view.definition:
SELECT id,
    embedding,
    retrieval_text AS text,
    jsonb_build_object('rag_item_id', (id)::text, 'source_type', source_type, 'fact_statement', (learning_data ->> 'fact_statement'::text), 'evidence', (learning_data ->> 'evidence_quote'::text), 'limitations', (learning_data ->> 'limitations'::text), 'verification_status', 'human_verified', 'factual_use_approved', true) AS metadata
   FROM rag_items
  WHERE ((source_type = 'employee_fact'::text) AND (approved = true) AND (active = true) AND (quality_status = 'approved'::text) AND (embedding IS NOT NULL) AND ((learning_data ->> 'verification_status'::text) = 'human_verified'::text) AND ((learning_data ->> 'factual_use_approved'::text) = 'true'::text));

rag_category_learning_view.definition:
SELECT id,
    embedding,
    retrieval_text AS text,
    jsonb_build_object('rag_item_id', (id)::text, 'source_type', source_type, 'question', customer_question, 'historical_category', category, 'original_categories', COALESCE((learning_data -> 'original_categories'::text), '[]'::jsonb), 'corrected_categories',
        CASE
            WHEN (source_type = 'classification_example'::text) THEN COALESCE((learning_data -> 'corrected_categories'::text), '[]'::jsonb)
            ELSE '[]'::jsonb
        END, 'correction_reason',
        CASE
            WHEN (source_type = 'classification_example'::text) THEN COALESCE((learning_data ->> 'rationale'::text), ''::text)
            ELSE ''::text
        END, 'correction_origin',
        CASE
            WHEN (source_type = 'classification_example'::text) THEN COALESCE((learning_data ->> 'category_correction_origin'::text), 'explicit_reason'::text)
            ELSE 'not_confirmed'::text
        END, 'employee_answer',
        CASE
            WHEN (source_type = 'response_example'::text) THEN "left"(COALESCE(human_answer, ''::text), 350)
            ELSE ''::text
        END, 'evidence_level',
        CASE
            WHEN (source_type = 'classification_example'::text) THEN 'explicit_employee_correction'::text
            ELSE 'historical_ai_label_unverified'::text
        END) AS metadata
   FROM rag_items r
  WHERE ((approved = true) AND (active = true) AND (quality_status = 'approved'::text) AND (embedding IS NOT NULL) AND ((length(btrim(COALESCE(retrieval_text, ''::text))) >= 12) AND (length(btrim(COALESCE(retrieval_text, ''::text))) <= 900)) AND (((source_type = 'classification_example'::text) AND ((learning_data ->> 'target_agent'::text) = 'classifier'::text) AND (jsonb_typeof((learning_data -> 'corrected_categories'::text)) = 'array'::text) AND (jsonb_array_length((learning_data -> 'corrected_categories'::text)) > 0)) OR ((source_type = 'response_example'::text) AND ((learning_data ->> 'target_agent'::text) = 'final_answer'::text) AND ((learning_data ->> 'example_role'::text) = 'style_only'::text) AND (category = ANY (ARRAY['bestellstatus'::text, 'bestellung'::text, 'versandstatus'::text, 'rechnung'::text, 'produktfragen'::text, 'firmenfragen'::text, 'reklamation'::text, 'spam'::text, 'human_needed'::text])))));

learning_case_publisher_candidates_v11.definition:
SELECT id,
    ((learning_data ->> 'case_revision'::text))::bigint AS revision,
    topic,
    customer_question,
    human_answer,
    feedback_reason,
    retrieval_text,
    updated_at
   FROM rag_items r
  WHERE ((source_type = 'case_example'::text) AND (quality_status = 'approved'::text) AND (active = false) AND (approved = false) AND (embedding IS NULL) AND (learning_data @> '{"case_status": "approved", "case_version": 11, "example_role": "historical_resolution", "target_agent": "case_retrieval", "publish_state": "unpublished", "privacy_checked": true, "quality_checked": true, "pipeline_version": 11, "factual_authority": false, "factual_use_approved": false, "generalization_checked": true, "requires_quality_review": true}'::jsonb) AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM ai_feedback f
          WHERE ((f.id = r.feedback_id) AND (((f.feedback_data -> 'learning_case_v11'::text) ->> 'status'::text) = 'staged'::text) AND (md5(((f.feedback_data -> 'learning_case_v11'::text))::text) = (r.learning_data ->> 'origin_digest'::text))))));

functions.learning_review_audit_guard():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learning_review_audit_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'review audit is append only'; END $function$
functions.learning_review_original_guard():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learning_review_original_guard()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF NEW.original IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.original THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'original review snapshot immutable'; END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
functions.learning_case_review_separation_v11():
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learning_case_review_separation_v11()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT FROM public.rag_items WHERE id=NEW.item_id AND source_type='case_example') THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'case examples require separate quality review';
 END IF;
 RETURN NEW;
END $function$
functions.learning_case_stage_v11(p_feedback uuid):
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learning_case_stage_v11(p_feedback uuid)
 RETURNS uuid
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  c jsonb;
  i uuid;
  ft text;
  f public.ai_feedback;
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO f
  FROM public.ai_feedback
  WHERE id = p_feedback
  FOR UPDATE;

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'feedback not found';
  END IF;

  c := f.feedback_data->'learning_case_v11';
  ft := f.feedback_type;

  IF public.learning_case_envelope_valid_v11(c) IS DISTINCT FROM true
     OR c->>'status' IS DISTINCT FROM 'staged'
     OR ft IS DISTINCT FROM c->>'feedback_type'
     OR NOT public.learning_case_human_source_valid_v11(f)
  THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'case is not staged';
  END IF;

  SELECT id INTO i
  FROM public.rag_items
  WHERE feedback_id = p_feedback
    AND source_type = 'case_example';

  IF FOUND THEN
    RETURN i;
  END IF;

  i := gen_random_uuid();

  INSERT INTO public.rag_items (
    id, source_type, scope, source_id, feedback_id,
    category, topic, customer_question, human_answer,
    feedback_reason, retrieval_text, embedding,
    approved, active, quality_status, learning_data
  )
  VALUES (
    i,
    'case_example',
    'global',
    p_feedback::text,
    p_feedback,

    COALESCE(
      NULLIF(btrim(c->'corrected_categories'->>0), ''),
      NULLIF(btrim(c->'original_categories'->>0), ''),
      'anderes'
    ),

    'Historischer Lösungsfall',
    c->>'customer_question',
    c->>'human_answer',
    c->>'feedback_reason',
    left(c->>'customer_question', 900),
    NULL,
    false,
    false,
    'pending',

    jsonb_build_object(
      'pipeline_version', 11,
      'case_version', 11,
      'case_revision', 0,
      'case_status', 'staged',
      'publish_state', 'unpublished',
      'target_agent', 'case_retrieval',
      'example_role', 'historical_resolution',
      'factual_authority', false,
      'factual_use_approved', false,
      'verification_status', 'not_applicable',
      'requires_quality_review', true,
      'privacy_checked', false,
      'quality_checked', false,
      'generalization_checked', false,
      'has_explicit_feedback', c->'has_explicit_feedback',
      'feedback_type', ft,
      'original_categories', c->'original_categories',
      'corrected_categories', c->'corrected_categories',
      'confirmed_categories', '[]'::jsonb,
      'origin_digest', md5(c::text)
    )
  );

  INSERT INTO public.learning_case_audit_v11 (
    item_id, revision, action, actor
  )
  VALUES (i, 0, 'stage', session_user);

  RETURN i;
END
$function$
functions.learning_case_human_source_valid_v11(f a:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.learning_case_human_source_valid_v11(f ai_feedback)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public'
AS $function$
 SELECT COALESCE(f.feedback_data->>'response_source'='human'
  AND f.agent_id ~ '^[1-9][0-9]*$'
  AND f.outgoing_message_uuid ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  AND f.mail_event_message_uuid ~* '^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$'
  AND length(btrim(f.human_answer))>0 AND octet_length(f.human_answer)<=1048576,false)
$function$
functions.commit_ai_feedback(p_id uuid, p_message_:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.commit_ai_feedback(p_id uuid, p_message_uuid text, p_conversation_uuid text, p_outgoing_uuid text, p_agent_id text, p_human_answer text, p_feedback_reason text, p_sent_at timestamp with time zone)
 RETURNS TABLE(id text, committed boolean, result text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
AS $function$
DECLARE
    v_event mail_events%ROWTYPE;
    v_existing ai_feedback%ROWTYPE;
    v_reason TEXT := NULLIF(BTRIM(p_feedback_reason), '');
    v_sent_at TIMESTAMP := p_sent_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC';
BEGIN
    IF p_id IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(p_message_uuid), '') IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(p_conversation_uuid), '') IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(p_outgoing_uuid), '') IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(p_agent_id), '') IS NULL
       OR NULLIF(BTRIM(p_human_answer), '') IS NULL
       OR p_sent_at IS NULL
       OR LENGTH(COALESCE(p_feedback_reason, '')) > 8000
    THEN
        RETURN QUERY SELECT p_id::TEXT, FALSE, 'invalid_input'::TEXT;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    SELECT *
    INTO v_event
    FROM mail_events m
    WHERE m.message_uuid = p_message_uuid
      AND m.conversation_uuid = p_conversation_uuid
      AND NULLIF(BTRIM(m.suggested_message), '') IS NOT NULL
    FOR UPDATE;

    IF NOT FOUND THEN
        RETURN QUERY SELECT p_id::TEXT, FALSE, 'mail_event_not_found'::TEXT;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    SELECT *
    INTO v_existing
    FROM ai_feedback f
    WHERE f.id = p_id
       OR f.outgoing_message_uuid = p_outgoing_uuid
    LIMIT 1;

    IF FOUND THEN
        IF v_existing.id = p_id
           AND v_existing.mail_event_message_uuid = p_message_uuid
           AND v_existing.outgoing_message_uuid = p_outgoing_uuid
           AND v_existing.agent_id = p_agent_id
           AND v_existing.human_answer = p_human_answer
           AND v_existing.feedback_reason IS NOT DISTINCT FROM v_reason
        THEN
            RETURN QUERY SELECT p_id::TEXT, TRUE, 'already_committed'::TEXT;
        ELSE
            RETURN QUERY SELECT p_id::TEXT, FALSE, 'conflict'::TEXT;
        END IF;
        RETURN;
    END IF;

    INSERT INTO ai_feedback (
        id,
        mail_event_message_uuid,
        outgoing_message_uuid,
        agent_id,
        human_answer,
        feedback_reason,
        feedback_type,
        quality_status
    )
    VALUES (
        p_id,
        p_message_uuid,
        p_outgoing_uuid,
        p_agent_id,
        p_human_answer,
        v_reason,
        NULL,
        'pending'
    );

    UPDATE mail_events
    SET
        sent_message = CASE
            WHEN sent_at IS NULL OR sent_at <= v_sent_at
            THEN p_human_answer
            ELSE sent_message
        END,
        response_source = CASE
            WHEN sent_at IS NULL OR sent_at <= v_sent_at
            THEN 'human'
            ELSE response_source
        END,
        agent_id = CASE
            WHEN sent_at IS NULL OR sent_at <= v_sent_at
            THEN p_agent_id
            ELSE agent_id
        END,
        sent_at = GREATEST(
            COALESCE(sent_at, v_sent_at),
            v_sent_at
        ),
        status_updated_at = NOW()
    WHERE message_uuid = p_message_uuid;

    RETURN QUERY SELECT p_id::TEXT, TRUE, 'created'::TEXT;
END;
$function$

constraints.rag_items.rag_case_contract_v11: CHECK (((source_type IS DISTINCT FROM 'case_example'::text) OR (((feedback_id IS NOT NULL) AND (source_id = (feedback_id)::text) AND (scope = 'global'::text) AND (ai_answer IS NULL) AND ((length(btrim(customer_question)) >= 12) AND (length(btrim(customer_question)) <= 6000)) AND ((length(btrim(human_answer)) >= 1) AND (length(btrim(human_answer)) <= 6000)) AND ((length(btrim(feedback_reason)) >= 0) AND (length(btrim(feedback_reason)) <= 6000)) AND ((length(btrim(retrieval_text)) >= 12) AND (length(btrim(retrieval_text)) <= 900)) AND (learning_data @> '{"case_version": 11, "example_role": "historical_resolution", "target_agent": "case_retrieval", "pipeline_version": 11, "factual_authority": false, "verification_status": "not_applicable", "factual_use_approved": false, "requires_quality_review": true}'::jsonb) AND ((learning_data ->> 'case_status'::text) = ANY (ARRAY['staged'::text, 'approved'::text, 'published'::text, 'rejected'::text, 'blocked'::text, 'disabled'::text])) AND (((learning_data ->> 'case_revision'::text))::bigint >= 0) AND ((NOT active) OR (approved AND (quality_status = 'approved'::text) AND (embedding IS NOT NULL) AND (learning_data @> '{"case_status": "published", "privacy_checked": true, "quality_checked": true, "generalization_checked": true}'::jsonb)))) IS TRUE)))
constraints.rag_items.rag_items_feedback_fk: FOREIGN KEY (feedback_id) REFERENCES ai_feedback(id) ON DELETE SET NULL
constraints.ai_feedback.ai_feedback_mail_event_fk: FOREIGN KEY (mail_event_message_uuid) REFERENCES mail_events(message_uuid) ON DELETE RESTRICT
